page.layout: One printed page on the scan, blank. At the far left edge a sliver of the facing page shows a fragment of black letter (Fraktur) text in a narrow strip; it belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. The digitiser's credit block at the bottom is left out.
page.notes: The page itself is blank: no printed text, heading, page number or signature is visible on it. Only stains, show-through and the edge of the neighbouring page appear. The fragment at the left edge (black letter lines and a partial word "CHYMIC" in capitals at the top, and a few lines ending in "...ALÆ.") belongs to the adjacent page and is excluded under the rules. The digitiser's credit text (Early European Books, ProQuest, Wellcome Trust, 4974/A) is excluded.
